positions.title: Director of Engineering & Operations
positions.description: As part of SME Group DC’s leadership team, lead engineering and operations, shape company strategy, and guide execution. Build technology solutions, develop teams, and improve processes to strengthen delivery across federal programs, grants management, and infrastructure projects.

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: As the first mobile engineer on the Capital One Travel app, helped shape its technical foundation and led the iOS team through development and launch in March 2026. Partnered closely with Product, Design, Android, and Platform engineering to take the app from concept to production.

positions.title: Manager/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of several features across Capital One’s flagship banking mobile app, serving over 10 million active customers. During this role, worked on the "Home" team, which owned the app’s highest-traffic screen.

positions.title: Signal Processing Engineer
positions.description: Led development of a tracker system for a state-of-the-art radar.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Machine learning, data science, statistical analysis.
